### Borea v0.7.0-dev.1: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and players who want to test v0.7.0 before it is released.
It is not for normal use.
For normal use, stay on v0.6.29.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test these first

- Library > Screenshots: check that the screenshots of all your instances and of the game profile show, newest first. Filter by an instance, open a picture, and use "Show in folder" and "Copy path" in its menu. Check that scrolling stays smooth with many screenshots.
- On the Game data tab of an instance with screenshots, check the six newest pictures and "Show all".
- Play an instance, take a few screenshots with Print Screen, and close the game. Borea should show how many new screenshots the game saved.
- Delete an instance that has screenshots. The dialog should say how many there are, and "Keep the screenshots" should copy them to `Pictures/Kitten Space Agency/<instance name>` before the instance goes.
- Share a vehicle or a save and add one of its screenshots with one click. A screenshot above 10 MB should be added as a smaller `.jpg` copy.
- On Linux and macOS, check that "Open screenshots folder", "Show in folder" and the Pictures folder work.

#### Before you go back to v0.6.29

- Nothing in your library changes. v0.6.29 simply does not show the screenshot features.
- Screenshots that you kept when you deleted an instance stay in your Pictures folder.

#### New since v0.6.29

Screenshots
- The Library has a Screenshots tab with the screenshots of all your instances and of the game profile in one place. Filter by instance, click a picture to open it, or use its menu to show it in its folder or copy its path. Thank you, @Kiwi-Shark, for the idea!
- The Game data tab of an instance shows its six newest screenshots, and "Show all" opens the gallery for that instance.
- When a game of an instance ends, a toast tells you how many new screenshots it saved and opens them.
- The Game data tab names its rows: Game settings, HUD layouts, Crash dumps, Screenshots and Other exports. The Screenshots row shows how many pictures the instance has and their size.
- The menu of an instance has "Open screenshots folder".
- The delete dialog says how many screenshots an instance has and keeps them by default. Borea copies them to your Pictures folder before it deletes the instance. If the copy fails, the instance stays.

Sharing
- The share dialog offers the screenshots of the instance as pictures, and the picture picker opens in the screenshots folder.
- A share picture above 10 MB is no longer refused. Borea saves it again as a JPEG, and makes it smaller only when that is not enough, so a 4K screenshot can be shared.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on.
When v0.7.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
